brief_zh: 講者：Christie L. M. Petrenko，臨床心理學家，羅徹斯特大學醫學院發展及行為兒科高級研究主任，專研胎兒酒精譜系障礙（FASD）
主題：FASD 知情照顧，包括 FASD 是甚麼、診斷如何幫忙、FASD 知情照顧的要點，並介紹 FMF Connect Pro 應用程式
費用：免費參加；1 個免費 CEU，適用於心理學家、社工、婚姻及家庭治療師、精神健康輔導員
形式：Zoom 線上；對象為照顧 FASD 或產前酒精暴露兒童（3–13 歲）的專業人員
caution: 時間為美國東岸時間（約香港時間 12 月 16 日凌晨 01:00–02:00）；講座同時介紹講者開發的 FMF Connect Pro 應用程式及相關研究招募，屬講者個人研究項目；報名前請再核對 CEU 安排。

posts.title: Introductory Webinar – FASD-Informed Care: Striving for Equity（2026 年 12 月 15 日場次）

summary_en: The Florida Center Training Institute's free introductory webinar takes place on Tuesday 15 December 2026, 12:00-1:00 p.m. Eastern Time (about 1:00-2:00 a.m. Hong Kong time on 16 December), presented by Christie L. M. Petrenko, PhD, clinical psychologist and Senior Research Director of Developmental & Behavioral Pediatrics at the University of Rochester Medical Center: 'FASD-Informed Care: Striving for Equity'. The session covers what fetal alcohol spectrum disorders (FASD) are, how a diagnosis helps, and what FASD-informed care looks like, and introduces the FMF Connect Pro app. Attendance is free and carries 1 free CEU for psychologists, social workers, marriage and family therapists and mental health counselors. It is aimed at professionals working with children aged 3-13 with FASD or prenatal alcohol exposure.
